<div class="card-body">
'''Ommni Box''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">オムニ・ボックス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のプレイヤーのリザーブデッキ、ロストデッキ、ユーズドデッキのいずれかをシャッフルできる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Ommni-Box-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Ommni Box (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Ommni-Box-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">扱いに熟練を要する楽器の一種。音楽を増幅する。モス・アイズリーのカンティーナで、フィグリン・ダン・アンド・モーダル・ノーズ楽団のテック・モアが演奏した。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Ommni Box.

'''Card text:''' You may shuffle any player's Reserve Deck, Lost Deck or Used Deck.

'''Lore:''' A type of musical instrument requiring skill to operate. It amplifies music. Tech Mo'r of Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes played it in the Mos Eisley Cantina.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Ommni Box]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
